    59	void buildSquare2D(World& world, int n_elems_root) {
    60	    const size_t n_elems = static_cast<size_t>(n_elems_root) * n_elems_root;
    61	    world.elements_dynamic.assign(n_elems, ElementDynamic{0.0, 0.0});
    62	}
    63	
    64	__device__ __forceinline__ val_t computeFlux(val_t this_energy,
    65	                                              val_t other_energy) {
    66	    // Preserve the reference expression's operation order.  CUDA contracts the
    67	    // final multiply/add just as the optimized host reference does.
    68	    return (other_energy - this_energy) * 0.8 * 1.0 * 0.25;
    69	}
    70	
    71	constexpr unsigned BLOCK_COLUMNS = 32;
    72	constexpr unsigned BLOCK_ROWS = 4;
    73	
    74	__global__ void simulationStep(const val_t* __restrict__ energy_in,
    75	                               val_t* __restrict__ energy_out,
    76	                               val_t* __restrict__ cumulative_flux,
    77	                               int n_elems_root) {
    78	    const unsigned local_y = threadIdx.x;
    79	    const unsigned local_x = threadIdx.y;
    80	    const unsigned y = blockIdx.x * BLOCK_COLUMNS + local_y;
    81	    const unsigned x = blockIdx.y * BLOCK_ROWS + local_x;
    82	    const unsigned root = static_cast<unsigned>(n_elems_root);
    83	    const bool valid = x < root && y < root;
    84	    const size_t index = static_cast<size_t>(x) * root + y;
    85	    if (!valid) {
    86	        return;
    87	    }
    88	
    89	    const val_t current_energy = energy_in[index];
    90	    const unsigned last = root - 1;
    91	    val_t total_flux = 0.0;
    92	
    93	    // These tests reproduce the final material assignments in buildSquare2D,
    94	    // including the n=1 case where all four corners alias the inflow element.
    95	    if ((x == 0 && y == 0) || (x == last && y == last)) {
    96	        total_flux = 0.5;
    97	    } else if ((x == 0 && y == last) || (x == last && y == 0)) {
    98	        total_flux = -0.5;
    99	    }
   100	
   101	    // Original connection order: +x, -x, +y, -y.
   102	    if (x + 1 < root) {
   103	        total_flux += computeFlux(current_energy, energy_in[index + root]);
   104	    }
   105	    if (x != 0) {
   106	        total_flux += computeFlux(current_energy, energy_in[index - root]);
   107	    }
   108	    if (y + 1 < root) {
   109	        total_flux += computeFlux(current_energy, energy_in[index + 1]);
   110	    }
   111	    if (y != 0) {
   112	        total_flux += computeFlux(current_energy, energy_in[index - 1]);
   113	    }
   114	
   115	    energy_out[index] = current_energy + total_flux;
   116	    cumulative_flux[index] += fabs(total_flux);
   117	}

   119	struct GpuSimulation {
   120	    val_t* allocation = nullptr;
   121	    val_t* energy[2] = {nullptr, nullptr};
   122	    val_t* cumulative_flux = nullptr;
   123	    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;
   124	    cudaGraph_t graph = nullptr;
   125	    cudaGraphExec_t graph_exec = nullptr;
   126	    cudaEvent_t start_event = nullptr;
   127	    cudaEvent_t stop_event = nullptr;
   128	    size_t n_elems = 0;
   129	    int final_energy_buffer = 0;
   130	
   131	    GpuSimulation() = default;
   132	    GpuSimulation(const GpuSimulation&) = delete;
   133	    GpuSimulation& operator=(const GpuSimulation&) = delete;
   134	
   135	    ~GpuSimulation() {
   136	        if (graph_exec != nullptr) {
   137	            cudaGraphExecDestroy(graph_exec);
   138	        }
   139	        if (graph != nullptr) {
   140	            cudaGraphDestroy(graph);
   141	        }
   142	        if (start_event != nullptr) {
   143	            cudaEventDestroy(start_event);
   144	        }
   145	        if (stop_event != nullptr) {
   146	            cudaEventDestroy(stop_event);
   147	        }
   148	        if (stream != nullptr) {
   149	            cudaStreamDestroy(stream);
   150	        }
   151	        if (allocation != nullptr) {
   152	            cudaFree(allocation);
   153	        }
   154	    }
   155	};
   156	
   157	void prepareSimulation(GpuSimulation& gpu, int n_elems_root, int n_iters) {
   158	    gpu.n_elems = static_cast<size_t>(n_elems_root) * n_elems_root;
   159	    gpu.final_energy_buffer = n_iters & 1;
   160	
   161	    int device = 0;
   162	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&device));
   163	    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
   164	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, device));
   165	
   166	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&gpu.stream, cudaStreamNonBlocking));
   167	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&gpu.start_event));
   168	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreate(&gpu.stop_event));
   169	
   170	    const size_t bytes_per_array = gpu.n_elems * sizeof(val_t);
   171	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&gpu.allocation),
   172	                          3 * bytes_per_array));
   173	    gpu.energy[0] = gpu.allocation;
   174	    gpu.energy[1] = gpu.allocation + gpu.n_elems;
   175	    gpu.cumulative_flux = gpu.allocation + 2 * gpu.n_elems;
   176	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemsetAsync(gpu.allocation, 0, 3 * bytes_per_array, gpu.stream));
   177	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(gpu.stream));
   178	
   179	    std::printf("CUDA device: %s (%d SMs)\n", properties.name,
   180	                properties.multiProcessorCount);
   181	
   182	    if (n_iters == 0) {
   183	        return;
   184	    }
   185	
   186	    const dim3 threads(BLOCK_COLUMNS, BLOCK_ROWS);
   187	    const dim3 blocks((n_elems_root + BLOCK_COLUMNS - 1) / BLOCK_COLUMNS,
   188	                      (n_elems_root + BLOCK_ROWS - 1) / BLOCK_ROWS);
   189	
   190	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamBeginCapture(gpu.stream, cudaStreamCaptureModeGlobal));
   191	    for (int iter = 0; iter < n_iters; ++iter) {
   192	        simulationStep<<<blocks, threads, 0, gpu.stream>>>(
   193	            gpu.energy[iter & 1], gpu.energy[(iter + 1) & 1],
   194	            gpu.cumulative_flux, n_elems_root);
   195	    }
   196	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamEndCapture(gpu.stream, &gpu.graph));
   197	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphInstantiate(&gpu.graph_exec, gpu.graph, nullptr, nullptr, 0));
   198	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphUpload(gpu.graph_exec, gpu.stream));
   199	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(gpu.stream));
   200	}
   201	
   202	double runSimulation(GpuSimulation& gpu) {
   203	    if (gpu.graph_exec == nullptr) {
   204	        return 0.0;
   205	    }
   206	
   207	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(gpu.start_event, gpu.stream));
   208	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGraphLaunch(gpu.graph_exec, gpu.stream));
   209	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(gpu.stop_event, gpu.stream));
   210	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(gpu.stop_event));
   211	
   212	    float duration_ms = 0.0F;
   213	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventElapsedTime(&duration_ms, gpu.start_event, gpu.stop_event));
   214	    return static_cast<double>(duration_ms);
   215	}

   223	        world.elements_dynamic[i].current_energy = staging[i];
   224	    }
   225	
   226	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(staging.data(), gpu.cumulative_flux,
   227	                          gpu.n_elems * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   228	    for (size_t i = 0; i < gpu.n_elems; ++i) {
   229	        world.elements_dynamic[i].total_flux = staging[i];
   230	    }

+__device__ __forceinline__ val_t computeFlux(val_t this_energy,
+                                              val_t other_energy) {
+    // Preserve the reference expression's operation order.  CUDA contracts the
+    // final multiply/add just as the optimized host reference does.
+    return (other_energy - this_energy) * 0.8 * 1.0 * 0.25;
